Funky plays in the park. Suddenly he hears: "Meow!"
Funky looks under the tree. Nobody is here...
Funky sees ducks in the pond, but no kitten.
The ducks say: "The kitten is hiding in the bush!"
Funky finds a little kitten in the bush. It is scared!
The kitten drinks the milk. It feels better now!
Funky holds the kitten softly. It starts to purr!
A girl opens the door: "Luna! My kitten! Thank you, Funky!"
Hooray! The kitten is home. You are a hero, Funky!
Funky has a red rocket. "Three, two, one... GO!"
The Moon is big and grey. Funky jumps super high here!
Mars is red and dusty. A friendly robot waves at Funky!
The moon rocks sparkle like diamonds. Beautiful!
The stars twinkle: twinkle, twinkle, little star...
The robot says: "Welcome to Mars, Funky!" and dances.
Click! What a beautiful photo of red Mars!
Funky lands safely on Earth. What a big adventure!
Great explorer! You travelled to space. The End!
